problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a set of freight packages onto standardized pallets for air shipment. The packages are as follows:

* Package Alpha: mass 48kg
* Package Bravo: mass 36kg
* Package Charlie: mass 45kg
* Package Delta: mass 49kg
* Package Echo: mass 66kg
* Package Foxtrot: mass 34kg
* Package Golf: mass 36kg
* Package Hotel: mass 55kg
* Package India: mass 60kg
* Package Juliet: mass 39kg
* Package Kilo: mass 50kg
* Package Lima: mass 44kg
* Package Mike: mass 38kg
* Package November: mass 45kg
* Package Oscar: mass 38kg
* Package Papa: mass 32kg
* Package Quebec: mass 66kg
* Package Romeo: mass 33kg
* Package Sierra: mass 59kg
* Package Tango: mass 60kg
* Package Uniform: mass 65kg
* Package Victor: mass 65kg
* Package Whiskey: mass 45kg
* Package X-ray: mass 57kg
* Package Yankee: mass 45kg
* Package Zulu: mass 43kg
* Package Asterisk: mass 69kg
* Package Backslash: mass 36kg
* Package Bracket: mass 51kg
* Package Caret: mass 41kg
* Package Underscore: mass 48kg
* Package Grave: mass 36kg
* Package a: mass 58kg
* Package b: mass 58kg

Each pallet has a certified maximum load capacity of 100 kg. The coordinator must assign every package to exactly one pallet, ensuring the cumulative mass on any pallet does not surpass its limit. The objective is to complete the allocation utilizing the minimal possible number of pallets.
